title: Vendor Operations Lead
description:
Role Summary 
 This role is responsible for leading end-to-end peer review operations while driving vendor governance, operational analytics, and continuous process improvement for GSD-OA. The incumbent will oversee internal editorial operations, manage vendor delivery performance, and leverage data-driven insights to optimize workflow efficiency, quality, and turnaround times. 
 The position plays a critical role in ensuring seamless manuscript progression from submission through production by maintaining operational excellence, strengthening stakeholder engagement, mitigating risks, and enabling scalable, performance-driven workflows across both internal and external teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Peer Review Operations & Team Leadership Lead and oversee end-to-end peer review operations from manuscript submission through handoff to production. Manage, mentor, and develop a team of 5-7 professionals, ensuring effective workload distribution and performance management. Drive daily and weekly operational planning to achieve productivity, quality, and turnaround time targets. Monitor team performance through defined KPIs, identify improvement opportunities, and implement development plans. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. Proactively identify and escalate operational, workflow, and people-related risks.
 Vendor Management & Governance Serve as the primary operational liaison for external vendor partners. Establish and maintain strong vendor relationships aligned with quality standards, SLAs, KPIs, and business objectives. Track vendor performance using scorecards, dashboards, and governance frameworks. Conduct regular performance reviews, feedback discussions, and service improvement initiatives. Manage operational escalations, compliance concerns, and delivery risks. Drive corrective and preventive actions to address performance gaps and ensure service excellence.
 Operational Analytics, Reporting & Capacity Planning Develop, maintain, and enhance operational dashboards, reports, and trackers using Excel and Power BI. Monitor key operational metrics including throughput, turnaround time, backlog, productivity, quality, and resource utilization. Analyze data trends to identify bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and process inefficiencies. Support workforce planning, forecasting, and capacity management through data-driven insights. Present actionable recommendations and performance insights to leadership stakeholders. Drive a culture of data-based decision-making across operations.
 Workflow Governance, Risk Management & Process Improvement Ensure consistent and efficient execution of peer review workflows across internal and vendor-supported operations. Identify operational bottlenecks, quality concerns, and turnaround time challenges, driving timely resolution. Monitor recurring issues and implement sustainable mitigation and preventive measures. Lead initiatives focused on workflow optimization, process standardization, and operational scalability. Continuously improve SOPs, governance frameworks, and operational controls. Champion operational excellence through Lean thinking and continuous improvement methodologies.
 Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration Build strong relationships with editors, authors, reviewers, publishers, and internal stakeholders globally. Partner closely with Editorial, Production, Technology, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure seamless workflow execution. Support vendor onboarding, training, knowledge transfer, and transition management activities. Act as a key communication bridge between global stakeholders, including US, UK, and offshore teams. Provide timely operational updates and drive stakeholder confidence through proactive communication.
 Process Governance & Documentation Ensure all process documentation, SOPs, training materials, and governance frameworks remain accurate and up to date. description:
Role: The Customer Success Lead North will be responsible for managing and strengthening relationships with key enterprise customers across the North region. The role will focus on driving customer adoption, engagement, retention, satisfaction, renewals, and revenue growth while acting as a strategic bridge between customers and internal teams. 
 The incumbent will own the overall customer lifecycle and account health, proactively identify risks and opportunities, manage escalations, and work closely with Sales, Product, Operations, and Service Delivery teams to ensure customers achieve maximum value from the company's solutions. 
 What You’d Do? 
 1. Relationship Management Build, manage, and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across assigned enterprise customer accounts Act as the primary relationship owner and strategic point of contact between customers and internal teams 
 2. Customer Lifecycle Ownership Own the end-to-end customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, engagement, retention, renewals, and account growth Develop a deep understanding of customers' business objectives, challenges, and use cases to ensure effective adoption and utilization of the company's products and solutions 
 3. Revenue Growth & Expansion Own the growth and revenue expansion strategy for assigned enterprise accounts across the North region Identify, develop, and convert upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities within existing customer accounts 
 4. Customer Health & Retention Monitor customer health, engagement, service performance, adoption, and satisfaction and proactively identify potential risks Drive initiatives to improve customer experience, product adoption, engagement, and long-term retention 
 5. Cross-functional Collaboration Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Service Delivery, and Support teams to address customer requirements Lead and manage critical customer escalations, ensuring appropriate internal coordination, communication, and closure 
 6. Strategic Reviews & Reporting Conduct regular business reviews and strategic discussions with customers to review performance and align on future growth opportunities. Maintain a structured account plan, customer pipeline, tracking opportunities, risks, engagement levels, and growth potential. Provide regular reporting on customer health, retention, revenue opportunities, churn risks, escalations and account forecasts to management 
 7. Team & Process Development Mentor and guide junior Customer Success / Service Management team members, sharing best practices and supporting their development Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Customer Success processes, frameworks, and governance Ensure consistent documentation of customer interactions, account plans, key risks, opportunities, and action items What You’d Have? 

 Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, Technology, or a related field; postgraduate qualification is an added advantage 10–12 years of experience in Customer Success, Key Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, Service Management, or Business Development Experience in the SaaS, CPaaS, Telecom, Cloud Communication, or Messaging industry will be preferred Proven track record in driving customer retention, renewals, account growth, upselling, and cross-selling Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, health monitoring, adoption, engagement, and retention strategies Experience managing customer escalations and coordinating cross-functional teams for issue resolution Strong business acumen with exposure to multiple industry verticals and enterprise customer environments Ability to communicate complex technology solutions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building, negotiation, and influencing skills Strong analytical skills to interpret customer performance, usage, revenue, and account health data Self-driven and proactive, with the ability to operate in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Experience in mentoring or leading junior team members is preferred
